sharedRules: Attribution captured silently on entry · a website in the first message skips the company question · snapshot revealed free after the last question · email + permission checkbox at the reveal · routing per routing.json overrides in order

campaigns.name: Master campaign (Stagwell.AI brand ad)
campaigns.landing: S1 master pattern — no product branding
campaigns.opener: What do you need help solving today?
campaigns.chipsNote: Mirrors questions.json q1.chips — Meta's objective words. Keep the two lists identical: flow.js resolves a chip to its domain by matching the q1 label, so a label that drifts here falls back to the classifier.

campaigns.name: The Machine
campaigns.opener: Most marketing stacks work fine on their own and badly together. Where does yours feel most fragmented — planning, creation, media, or measurement?
campaigns.openerNote: fuses Q1 + adaptive Q6 — one less question
campaigns.routeBias: consultative — core ICP is CMO/CCO/CDO at $1B+ enterprises; mid-market gets consultative scoping; SMB gets redirected to the concrete need the answers surface

campaigns.name: Agent Cloud
campaigns.opener: Every team has one job they'd hand to an AI tomorrow if they trusted it. What's yours?
chips: Making images and video from a brief
Building assistants the whole team can use
Getting our AI use secure and sanctioned
campaigns.routeBias: [to confirm with TMC] — self-serve trial if Agent Cloud ships one, otherwise demo
campaigns.chipsNote: One chip per service Agent Cloud actually sells, in the visitor's words: the toolkit's copy and messaging teammates; the image and video models on the platform (Veo3, Gemini 2.5, GPT-5); the research and social-listening integrations; the custom assistants its own testimonial calls the differentiator (500+ built); and the governance pillar — data never trains the LLMs, role-based access, one contract in place of unsanctioned tools. Sources: data/products.json valueProps and reference/companies/README.md.

campaigns.name: The Targeting Machine
campaigns.opener: Your first-party data is almost certainly worth more than it's returning. What would you want to do with it?
chips: Build audiences from my first-party data
campaigns.q6Override: Where does your first-party data live — a CDP, a data warehouse, or mostly in the ad platforms?
campaigns.routeBias: demo for mid-market/enterprise; data scattered in platforms → consultative scoping; SMB → nurture with snapshot

campaigns.name: NewVoices
campaigns.opener: Every call that goes unanswered is a customer deciding something. What would you want a voice agent handling first?
campaigns.routeBias: [to confirm — NewVoices to supply positioning, chips, self-serve vs. demo packaging]; the 'Let the machine call you' callback CTA is a natural fit
campaigns.chipsNote: The four use cases NewVoices publishes — sales, service, retention, feedback — the same four its landing page value cards carry.
